paragraphs: Outside of code, I write romantasy fiction under the pen name Hestia Hearthwood. I'm currently working on Blood Memory, a vampire romantasy following a reincarnated heroine navigating a centuries-old succession conflict, compulsion magic, and the pull of a bond she doesn't fully understand yet.
I'm also developing a new series, set on a colonized world shaped by bloodline-based powers — more details to come as it takes shape.
